review_scope.text_review: Exhaustive review of lesson text, headings and ledes, visual labels and descriptions, media summaries and bridges, recaps, next-tile previews, and remediation text. Referenced dataset content was reviewed directly in the scenario asset registry.
review_scope.interaction_review: Prompts, options or item records, instructions, hints and feedback reviewed for the listed sample. Sampling was expanded beyond approximately one third to include every tile.

findings_summary: No reviewed content requires understanding a concept in its tile's blocked_future_concepts. Next-tile previews are passing introductions rather than prerequisites for current tasks. Tile 121's separation of authorization from supplied locking configuration follows its own required facts; neither its explanation nor its sampled task requires understanding lock-file configuration or contention testing. The Terraform apply approval mentioned in tile 122's media summary is not an environment-promotion manual-approval gate. Referenced datasets remain within the concepts taught by their consuming tiles. No blocking or advisory leakage defects identified.
